scenario.name: The Ashen March
scenario.description: Recover the Ashen Monastery and defeat the Ember Warlord while your Palace stands. Other lairs offer optional treasure and safer borders.

crown.name: Crown Charter
crown.description: 1,500 starting gold. Standard guild prices and tax income.

guild_compact.name: Guild Compact
guild_compact.description: Guild construction costs 15% less. Periodic Palace, cottage and Marketplace taxes are 10% lower. Recruitment and research keep their normal prices.

untroubled.name: Untroubled Province
untroubled.description: Standard threats and treasure. A three-minute opening before scheduled Palace raids.

rich_ruins.name: Rich Ruins
rich_ruins.description: Original frontier lairs drop 25% more gold for heroes. Their defenders and reinforcements have 10% more health. The monastery and Warlord are unchanged.

hints.recruit: Select a completed guild and choose Recruit. Heroes act on their own; you provide the buildings, services and incentives.
hints.bounty: Use Bounties to mark a hostile site or an exploration spot. Select an existing flag to raise its reward. An offer does not guarantee obedience.
hints.retreat: A wounded hero is returning to recover. Guilds and the Palace provide free rest; a Temple improves recovery. Potions can help on the road.
hints.shopping: Heroes buy potions with their own gold. You fund Marketplace research; collectors deliver the proceeds back to the Palace.
